scheme_name: Chief Minister EBC Civil Seva Protsahan Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar.
The applicant must belong to the Extremely Backward Class (EBC) category.
The applicant must have passed the preliminary examination of a competitive exam such as UPSC, BPSC, Bihar Judicial Service, NDA, CDS, Banking, Railway, SSC, etc.
The applicant must not have previously received the same incentive from any other source.
benefits_summary: Provides a cash incentive ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹1,00,000 for candidates who clear the preliminary examination of various competitive exams.
